targetText: (The history of the British labour movement provides a very large number of instances of such treacherous compromises by British trade union leaders, but, in one form or another, almost all workers in all countries have witnessed the same sort of thing.
explanation: Lenin refutes ultra-leftists who wanted to abandon conservative trade unions. Revolutionaries must work inside flawed mass institutions where real workers are located.

targetText: No Compromises? In the quotation from the Frankfurt pamphlet, we have seen how emphatically the “Lefts” have advanced this slogan.
explanation: Distinguishing between necessary tactical compromises that preserve organizational strength vs. opportunist surrenders of principle is essential for political leadership.
